differences.a_observable: The 'Recurly' and 'hyperswitch' buttons are aligned horizontally across the frame.
differences.b_observable: The 'Recurly' button is positioned significantly higher than the 'hyperswitch' button, creating a diagonal layout.
differences.fix: Align the buttons horizontally to match the reference layout.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are noticeably darker than the center, showing a clear vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are almost as bright as the center, lacking a vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect in post-processing or adjust camera lens shading.

differences.a_observable: The yellow button has a warm, golden color cast.
differences.b_observable: The yellow button has a cooler, greenish-yellow color cast.
differences.fix: Adjust the color temperature of the yellow material to be warmer.

differences.a_observable: The buttons exhibit soft specular highlights and a semi-glossy finish.
differences.b_observable: The buttons appear completely matte with no specular reflections.
differences.fix: Increase the specular intensity and adjust roughness on the button materials.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the layout of the buttons to align them horizontally as in the reference, and enhance the lighting with stronger shadows and a vignette to match the depth of Video A.
